name: Caelum Mirrorwright
lore: A copper-cloaked mirror craftswoman with a braided mane and a polished hand mirror.

primary.name: Facet Spear
primary.description: A crystal spear pierces up to two enemies for 25 damage each. Walls stop it.

secondary.name: Silver Shatter
secondary.description: Tap to fire three silver mirror shards in a forgiving fan (12 damage each). Hold up to 1.2s for larger shards dealing 19.2 each. Each shard pierces two foes; Twin Self echoes the fan at 60% damage.

special.name: Twin Self
special.description: For 6 seconds, your identical reflection copies your movement, aim, primary and secondary attacks (60% damage). It has 60% of current HP, capped at 66. If either body falls, continue with the survivor; losing both defeats you.

passive: Clear Sight: Silver Shatter also slows enemies it hits for 2 seconds.

technique.name: Patient Reflection
technique.description: Twin Self lasts 35% longer, but recharges 40% slower.

final_technique.name: Silver Scissors
final_technique.description: Two silver cuts cross and return: 13 damage per leg. Replaces the straight facet spear with timing and curved coverage.

attack.name: Silver Scissors
attack.description: Two silver cuts cross and return: 13 damage per leg. Replaces the straight facet spear with timing and curved coverage.
